declaredIdentity: tenant/work-digest-dispatches/memberId with dictionary weekOf children. Schedule rejects duplicates/future-known-week; processor deterministic messageId. Physical OCC claims prevent concurrent send. No-op bool does not compare changed schedule intent as conflict.
invariant: Technical dispatch invariant: one reservation/message per member-week, one in-flight send, retries only after definite transient rejection, and ambiguous external outcome freezes until authorized evidence-backed retry.
boundaryRationale: Split historical member roster into per-member-week dispatch process keyed by business delivery identity, retaining only narrow member scheduling cursor if monotonic week admission is required. Unknown-delivery holds and explicit evidence authorizations must remain durable; never replace with projection or blind retry.
logicalPhysicalRule: Logical technical responsibility is separate from physical storage/owner. Existing native operational journals may remain where required for exact recovery; this inventory does not require conversion to KV/CAS or count them as business authority.
